reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes buying OneCoin packages and placing the resulting tokens into a mining pool while presenting projected coin-price increases and large euro profits as reasons to participate. The speaker explicitly explains how a package could produce 275 coins and calculates earnings of 1650 euros, while the description urges viewers to join and become part of the growing cryptocurrency. Although one slide labels a calculation as illustrative, the overall presentation is an affirmative sales pitch for paid packages linked to mining and token appreciation.

citations.quote: As soon as you upgrade the package you have the option to submit these 11,000 tokens to the company's online exchange and put them in the mining pool
then you are earning 1650 euros
Join now and be a part of world growing digital cryptocurrency.

opening.argument: The numerical material is expressly presented as conditional and illustrative, not as a guaranteed outcome. The speaker says, “if we assume” the rate remains stable, and separately describes the calculations as only explanatory. The mining-pool slide itself says the calculation is “for illustration purpose only,” while the growth chart qualifies its figures as predictions dependent on community commitment and effort. Those qualifications matter: they frame the figures as scenarios and forecasts whose realization is uncertain, rather than promises that viewers will receive a return.

citations.quote: if we assume that in next 2-3 months its rate will not increase and it will stay stable here
then these calculations are just to explain you

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution treats the hypothetical arithmetic as a deceptive promise, but its own cited material omits the qualifications attached to that arithmetic. The slide identifies the calculation as illustrative, and the growth chart describes its figures as predictions dependent on participant commitment and effort. “Then you are earning 1650 euros” occurs inside an expressly assumed example; it does not establish that the speaker guaranteed that result. The invitation to join describes cryptocurrency participation, not certainty of profit.

citations.quote: if we assume that in next 2-3 months its rate will not increase and it will stay stable here

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The qualifications do not neutralize the commercial message. The presentation still links a paid package to placing tokens in a mining pool and then calculates a specific euro return. The phrase “for illustration purpose only” labels the arithmetic, but the surrounding presentation supplies concrete package and token mechanics rather than a neutral risk analysis. The growth chart also depicts projected appreciation, including an optimistic scenario, which reinforces the incentive to purchase despite the disclaimer.

citations.quote: As soon as you upgrade the package you have the option to submit these 11,000 tokens to the company's online exchange and put them in the mining pool

opening.argument: The material can be read as a basic instructional presentation about cryptocurrency concepts, trading and the operation of a token system. The title identifies it as a “Basic Presentation,” the speaker says purchasers receive training, and the course slide lists cryptocurrency analysis, trading fundamentals and coin-price analysis as educational content. The speaker also explains two alternatives for handling tokens, which is consistent with demonstrating how the model is described rather than reporting a completed investment outcome. Nothing supplied establishes that the video documents an actual successful return.

citations.quote: OneCoin Concept Basic Presentation Urdu
any package you are purchasing you are being provided with training
The second option is that you do not put them on the mining immediately and you wait for the split.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling it a presentation does not prove that its central function was merely educational. The supplied description says “Join now,” and the lesson moves from package purchasing to token allocation and projected profits. The presence of training content can describe what buyers receive without changing the fact that the presentation explains why someone should buy. The two alternatives are still framed around upgrading a package and obtaining coins, not detached cryptocurrency theory.

citations.quote: Join now and be a part of world growing digital cryptocurrency.
any package you are purchasing you are being provided with training
As soon as you upgrade the package

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The educational framing is not faithful to the presentation’s practical emphasis. The course slide is presented alongside product packages, and the speaker explains what a purchaser receives, how many tokens result, and how those tokens may enter a mining pool. The lesson therefore functions as product-oriented instruction supporting participation, not simply general education. Explaining two token options does not remove the purchase and return context.

citations.quote: any package you are purchasing you are being provided with training
As soon as you upgrade the package you have the option to submit these 11,000 tokens to the company's online exchange and put them in the mining pool

opening.argument: The observable transaction is presented as a package combining online education with tokens, which is compatible with ordinary commerce for a product and service. The package slide expressly says the packages relate to online education, and the speaker describes training as included. The supplied material does not show a request for bank credentials, a downline commission scheme, or a guaranteed return. It instead describes a limited Christmas and New Year promotion and gives an example of how tokens might be exchanged under an assumed future price. Those facts support treating this as a product presentation whose safety cannot be inferred either way from the arithmetic alone.

citations.quote: any package you are purchasing you are being provided with training and you get free of cost tokens in your account
because it's a 3 week promotion for Christmas and New Year

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution cannot turn ordinary packaging into ordinary commerce merely by calling the contents education. The package prices are tied to token quantities, and the presentation explains submitting those tokens to a mining pool and converting a hypothetical price increase into euro earnings. A missing credential request or downline reference is not decisive: the relevant mechanism shown is paid packages linked to mining and appreciation. The promotion language also creates urgency rather than removing the investment-like pitch.

citations.quote: put them in the mining pool
then you are earning 1650 euros

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The commerce label cannot account for the return-oriented structure. The package table displays escalating prices and token allocations, while the mining example turns a package-derived token amount into a projected euro gain. The fact that training is included does not explain why price appreciation, mining-pool placement and profit ranges occupy the same presentation. Nor does the absence of credential collection disprove a paid-return mechanism; the shown mechanism is the sale of packages associated with tokens and projected gains.

if its rate increases to 5 or 6 euros and you trade your 275 coins for 6 euros for example then you are earning 1650 euros
